system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You are a Data Transforming Agent. Your job is to transform data from a given format, to the same format as the target data.
system_prompt_style.note: No separate system message: single prompt_text strings built with f-strings/.format() from task/dataset variables (task_plan/plan_agent.py, data_format/format_agent.py get_format_prompt).

env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: harness injects static dataset/task/module descriptions and data samples into prompts; there are no navigation tools. None of the listed values fits exactly; added to Ambiguities.

context_compaction.note: Paper Sec. 3.4 describes dynamic memory pruning and README mentions memory_length, but the code that rewrites memory was not in the truncated excerpt of pa_agent.py. The scratchpad is reset each step, but that alone is not enough to code the dimension.

observation_format.note: All LLM I/O is text; training metrics are fed back as text.

tool_call_format.note: Param agent emits a dict parsed via json.loads after an LLM extraction pass. Format agent emits python code that is extracted by an LLM (format_agent.py parse_code). Plan agent uses option letters via extract_choice.

tool_count.note: No tool schemas are sent to the model. Actions are fixed-format text answers (choices, dicts, code).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: 7. Save transformed data in '{output_file}'.Do not use to_excel function of panda.
edit_primitive.note: There is no file-editing tool. Per the paper, the parameter agent generates code to update config files; no edit primitive is exposed.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schemas exist in the shown code. Not applicable.

protocol_standardization.note: The dependency list and a full grep were not available because the bundle was truncated.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: while not self.is_halted() and not self.is_finished() and int(self.step_n) <= int(self.max_steps):
loop_primitives.note: The staged pipeline is Data Preprocessing → Model Selection → Data Augmentation → Parameter Optimization (README). The optimization loop proposes settings, trains the model, scores the result, and iterates (Reflexion-style).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Please choose the most suitable one among A, B, C as the answer to this question.
planning_granularity.note: The plan agent picks a module combination; no stored plan object is shown.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: For each step, we design an expert agent to perform the corresponding operations effectively.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The input of the planning module is the task name and description from the understanding module

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: automated processing chain from user query to final result, eliminating the need for human-in-the-loop.

long_term_memory.note: Memory in pa_agent is per-run (reset in __reset_agent). Cross-run persistence was not visible in the truncated code.

self_verification.note: The harness trains the model and feeds evaluation metrics back to the agent (train_model/get_model_result).

retry_policy.evidence_quote: if (step_score - self.threshold)/self.threshold >= self.enhance:  #若某步优化效果超过self.enhance,则可以停止优化，提前结束
retry_policy.note: Iterates until the enhancement threshold is met, capped by max_steps.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: while not self.is_halted() and not self.is_finished() and int(self.step_n) <= int(self.max_steps):
termination_condition.note: The test_pass value here corresponds to the metric-improvement threshold being reached.

timeouts.note: reset_period=1800 triggers reflection, not a timeout.

execution_isolation.note: Models run via shell scripts in host conda environments.

tracing.note: jsonlines is imported in pa_agent, but the logging code was not visible.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Evaluation datasets for the natural-language command parsing are generated by the scripts under `evaluate_userQuery/`
